summary: Dealer Payments feature tested end-to-end. BACKEND: 21/21 pytest cases PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_payment_accounts.py — auth gating (401 without bearer on create/list/upcoming/PUT/DELETE/confirm), create validation (frequency/empty-label 400, bogus dealer 404), list sorted by next_due_date, monthly day-clamp (2026-03-31+1mo→2026-04-30) and weekly (+7d) advance on confirm, autopay catch-up (past due 2026-05-01 monthly → multiple auto:true payment records + next_due_date is FUTURE), upcoming?days=7 includes near-due and excludes far-future + exposes days_until/overdue/autopay/remind_day_before/remind_day_of, PUT update + invalid frequency 400, DELETE 404 on bogus, owner scoping (2nd test user TEST_payacct_*@example.com cannot see admin payment accounts via list or upcoming — confirmed via _ScopedCollection proxy that auto-injects owner_id), 'dealer_payment_accounts' present in BACKUP_COLLECTIONS in /app/backend/backups.py. FRONTEND: After fixing a CRITICAL syntax error in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (stray garbage lines 1818-1821 'nter",\n    marginTop: 16,...' that broke the Metro bundler and prevented the entire frontend from compiling — Expo was returning HTTP 500), the dealer detail screen now renders the SCHEDULED PAYMENTS section with the ADD PAYMENT ACCOUNT button (testID add-payment-account) and the empty-state copy. Note: I was unable to fully verify the modal opening via Playwright (force-click on the PillButton didn't fire the React onPress in the headless web preview, so modal testIDs pay-label/pay-amount/freq-*/pay-due-date/pay-autopay/pay-remind-before/pay-remind-dayof/pay-save were not visible — recommend main agent self-verify the modal flow). Home payments banner and More→CUSTOMIZE toggles could not be verified in this run for the same reason. All testIDs are present in source code (verified in /app/frontend/src/sections/PaymentAccountsSection.tsx and /app/frontend/src/components/PaymentsDueBanner.tsx).
action_items: Self-verify the ADD PAYMENT ACCOUNT modal flow on web preview — tap 'ADD PAYMENT ACCOUNT' on a dealer detail screen, confirm the bottom-sheet Modal opens with testIDs pay-label, pay-amount, freq-weekly/biweekly/monthly, pay-due-date, pay-autopay, pay-remind-before, pay-remind-dayof and SAVE button pay-save. (My headless Playwright force-click on the PillButton did not consistently fire onPress; the API + section render are both verified.)

Self-verify the Home banner (testID home-payments-banner) renders when an account is due within 7 days, and that More→CUSTOMIZE toggle-payments-banner / toggle-payment-notifications switches are present and the banner toggle actually hides the banner.

Investigate Metro disk cache corruption: 'Error while reading cache, falling back to a full crawl: Error: Unable to deserialize cloned data due to invalid or unsupported version' appears on every Expo restart. Clearing /app/frontend/.metro-cache fixed the run but the cache may rot again across container restarts.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend implementation is solid: a single _advance_payment_date helper handles weekly/biweekly/monthly with proper day-clamp (verified 2026-03-31 monthly → 2026-04-30). Autopay catch-up has a guard=120 loop bound — safe.

Owner scoping is implemented globally via the _ScopedCollection proxy (server.py L71+) which auto-injects {owner_id: <current_user>} on every find/update/insert/delete — so even though the PaymentAccount endpoints don't explicitly filter, isolation is enforced. Verified live by registering a second user and confirming none of admin's accounts leak through list or upcoming.

Auth gating is global via the @app.middleware('http') attach_user_to_context middleware (server.py L264-322), so all /api/payment-accounts/* and /api/dealers/*/payment-accounts endpoints return 401 without a bearer token (verified live for all 6 verbs).
BACKUP_COLLECTIONS in backups.py correctly includes 'dealer_payment_accounts' on line 44.

PaymentAccountsSection.tsx is well structured (~449 lines, under the 700 guideline) with testIDs on every interactive element. PaymentsDueBanner.tsx is self-contained and reads pref show_payments_banner.

The /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx file is ~1817 lines — over the 700-line guideline — and the broken edit at lines 1818-1821 demonstrates the risk of large files. Recommend splitting the Home screen into smaller modules (HomeStats, HomeBanners, HomeBacklog, etc.).
updated_files: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/index.tsx (removed 4 stray garbage lines that caused Metro syntax error)
